# claude-skill-awwwards — tponscr-debug

**Repo:** https://github.com/tponscr-debug/claude-skill-awwwards · **Install:** git clone into `.claude/skills/awwwards` (the README's own instruction).
**In the set:** 1 tool — `awwwards` (112 lines, `user-invocable: true`).

## What it is

Awwwards-winning design principles applied as one skill: visual ambition, motion, layout drama.
Its trigger is broad ("designing UIs, creating frontends, improving visual design"), which is the
reason it is not routed — it would fire on everything.

## The contract

Orchestrator-class: own context, art-direction decisions included. On a YOURSAUNAS surface the
brand contract still wins.

## Engage

- Direct only: `/design-tools:awwwards <target>`. For a whole surface, `design-pipeline`.
